messages:
olivia (customer): Hey—we're seeing intermittent 'invalid JSON' when calling /v1/generate with response_format=json and strict=true. Happens ~2x/day, responses sometimes return HTML which breaks our parser. Example curl below.

maria (support): Thanks — can you paste the curl + full response headers (esp x-request-id)? Are you setting any custom Accept headers?

olivia (customer): curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \n  -H "Accept: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"hi","response_format":"json","strict":true}'

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
X-Request-Id: abcd-1234-efgh

<html>...auth redirect/billing banner...</html>

olivia (customer): Parser fails because body is HTML not JSON. We expect a 4xx from strict enforcement, not HTML.

sam (eng): Got the x-request-id — thanks. Quick hypothesis: our strict-response negotiation is matching exact content-type and we may be ignoring the charset param when checking compatibility, causing a fallback to HTML from an upstream redirect/cache. Will dig. Any throttles/billing events around that ts?

tariq (sre): Checked logs for x-request-id=abcd-1234-efgh — upstream edge returned a 302 -> HTML page (auth). Edge then served cached HTML because Accept negotiation failed: our matcher treated "application/json; charset=utf-8" as not equal to "application/json" in strict mode in one of the legacy code paths. That made strict negotiation fall back to permissive path which allowed HTML through.

sam (eng): Repro locally with curl using the exact Content-Type header; I can reproduce on canary edge. Repro steps I ran:
```
curl -i -X POST https://canary-redwood-edge/v1/generate \n -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \n -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \n -H 'Accept: application/json' \n -d '{"prompt":"test","response_format":"json","strict":true}'
```
Response: 200 + text/html body when edge hits an auth redirect.

maria (support): Workaround for customers: remove the charset from Content-Type or set Accept to "application/json; q=1" or add header "Prefer: redwood-strict". Can you try one and confirm? :thinking_face:

olivia (customer): Tried removing charset from Content-Type — fixed, now returns proper JSON and parser OK. :white_check_mark:

tariq (sre): We're scheduling a patch to the strict content-type matcher to normalize charset params before comparison. Patch PR created, will roll to canary tonight and prod early next week. Incident ticket: SUPPORT-12345.

sam (eng): Also adding an extra defensive check: if response_format=json and content-type != application/json (ignoring params) then return 422 not 200. That prevents HTML slip-through.

maria (support): Escalating to infra & releasing the workaround to the KB article (support.redwood.ai/kb/json-strict-workaround). Assigning to sam/tariq. @olivia we'll keep this thread updated and link the SUPPORT ticket.

olivia (customer): Appreciate the quick turnaround — workaround works for our fleet, will revert once patch is live.

redwood-deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-02-10T03:45Z: canary rollout started for "strict-contenttype-normalize" (sha: a1b2c3).
